title: Default value of state variable not working with reducer function
version: unknown (body lists langchain-core 0.3.66; no langgraph version; commenter used 1.2.12)
observed_behavior: A pydantic state field declared as Annotated[list[str], extend_list] with default_factory ['default'] loses that default when the graph is invoked with an empty input: the reducer channel starts as an empty list, so only the node's value is present instead of ['default', ...].
structure_focus: Reducer channel initialization vs declared field default (BinaryOperatorAggregate starts as typ(), LastValue uses MISSING)
notes: Open. The issue body contains only the state declaration (no graph code), so graph_visible is false; the fixture wraps it in the trivial single-node graph needed to exercise the reducer. Commenters trace the root cause to BinaryOperatorAggregate.__init__ seeding typ() (e.g. list()) instead of the configured default, and propose a fix/PR; the maintainer thread treats it as a real default-initialization bug. source_type=framework; the fixture keeps the pydantic state with a mutating extend_list reducer.
